adminHelp: In OBS, add a browser source on the overlay address. To push an alert from another tool:
noToken: No sending code set: only the test alert works. To set one: “Settings” tab, “Sending code” option (advanced mode).
ytHelp: Super Chats, Super Stickers and memberships on your YouTube live appear here, one after the other. They come from the YouTube live actions module, which reads the chat **only while its “Live” page is open**: keep it open during the live. Message texts stay hidden unless you tick “Show the text of YouTube messages” in the settings.
ytTestError: The test alert could not be prepared.
ytAbsent: To also show Super Chats and memberships from your YouTube live, install the “YouTube live actions” module.
tw_f_min_gift: Smallest number of gifted subs shown
tw_f_min_help: Smaller ones are not shown. Empty or 0 shows everything.
tw_intro: Choose which Twitch events appear on screen, and how they read.
tw_linked: Twitch activity is linked: open its settings
tw_absent: To show your Twitch events, install the module Twitch activity.
tw_preset_ok: The {style} style is applied to every type.
tw_f_template_help: Plain words. Words between braces are replaced: {name} {count} {amount} {tier} {months} {viewers} {level} {title} {text} {total}. Empty restores the default sentence.
tw_f_seconds_help: Between 2 and 60 seconds. Empty uses the duration of the Settings tab.
tw_err_type: This type does not exist. Reload the page, for example with F5.
tw_err_template: Unknown word: {words}. Use only {vars}, for example {name} follows you.
tw_err_long: The text is too long. Write {n} characters at most, for example Thanks {name}.
tw_err_seconds: Write a whole number from {min} to {max}, for example 8.
tw_err_min: Write a whole number from 0 to {max}, for example 100.
q_running: Alerts are running. Waiting to be grouped: {n}.
q_paused: Alerts are paused. {n} held, they come out when you resume.
q_pause_ok: Paused: new alerts are held, nothing is lost.
